title: Longitudinal and personalized networks of eating disorder cognitions and behaviors: Targets for precision intervention a proof of concept study
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subjects network, intraindividual network
limitations: - Small sample size; - Limited number of assessment points (28); - No formal recommendations for choosing symptoms for network analysis; - No established psychometric properties for EMA measures used; - Lack of replicability of within-person networks; - Potential instability in network structures; - Time-frame limitations in capturing dynamic relationships
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. Code and data availability are not clearly declared in the paper, but supplementary materials or code may be available through the authors or OSF. The study is a proof-of-concept and findings should be interpreted cautiously due to methodological limitations.
